title: APPROVE REQUEST FOR 2026-2029 ON-CALL MULTIMODAL PLANNING CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENTS WITH: DB E.C.O. NORTH AMERICA INC., HATCH ASSOCIATES CONSULTANTS, INC., ITERIS INC., LOGSUM LLC, MOFFATT & NICH
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVE REQUEST FOR 2026-2029 ON-CALL MULTIMODAL PLANNING CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENTS WITH: DB E.C.O. NORTH AMERICA INC., HATCH ASSOCIATES CONSULTANTS, INC., ITERIS INC., LOGSUM LLC, MOFFATT & NICHOL, AND WSP USA INC.
Summary
: Staff requests approval of on-call professional services agreements for a term of three years each, for the cumulative amount of $1,397,000, between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and the following six firms: DB E.C.O. North America Inc.(DB), Hatch Associates Consultants, Inc. (Hatch), Iteris, Inc. (Iteris), LogSum LLC (LogSum), Moffatt & Nichol (M&N), and WSP USA Inc. (WSP). The Goods Movement Division (GMD) requires outside professional services for a variety of purposes including, but not limited to, the following: grant applications; traffic studies, and terminal/rail system simulation and capacity analyses. These services pertain to, and aid in implementing Objective 1 (World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth) of the “Port of Los Angeles 2026-2030 Strategic Plan,” and specifically Initiatives 1 and 3. The Harbor Department will be financially responsible for payment of expenses incurred under the proposed agreements.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with the Los Angeles City Charter Section 1022, work under the subject agreements can be performed more feasibly by outside consultants than by City employees; 3) approve and award six on-call professional services agreements for a term of three years each to the following firms (and not-to-exceed amounts): DB ($237,000), Hatch ($251,000), Iteris ($224,000), LogSum ($237,000), M&N ($224,000) and WSP ($224,000); 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to said agreements, for and on behalf of the Board; and 5) adopt Resolution No. __________.
